title: Review and remediation — the price-drift fix that touches totals and tax
feature: Devin Review: effort levels, Bugs vs Flags, the always-on Security section, quoting a finding into chat, re-review on new commits (and the unchanged-diff skip), and review rules in the Review settings rules editor
prerequisites: Lab 00 done (or you know the Kadé brands and planted-defect rule)
Repo connected to your Devin org; `npm install` done at the root; Postgres up (`npm run db:up`)
You can open pull requests on the repo and your Devin role can run Devin Review (see section 6)

matrix.integration: Devin Review — run a review, read Bugs / Flags / Security, chat on the PR
matrix.fixture: Read the committed reference findings in labs/06-review-remediation/fixtures/review-findings.json and the PR diff in fixtures/price-drift-fix.patch
matrix.note: Without the permission to run Devin Review you can still open the PR and read existing findings; the AI review actions are hidden

matrix.integration: Review settings — rules editor (review rules and exclusions)
matrix.fixture: Write the rule you would add (target glob plus rule text) in your evidence; the repo-level `services/api/REVIEW.md` on the exercise branch is the rule you are replacing
matrix.note: Editing org review settings needs an admin; a REVIEW.md on your remediation branch works for everyone

matrix.integration: GitHub write access (push a remediation branch, open a PR)
matrix.fixture: Apply fixtures/price-drift-fix.patch on a local throwaway branch `lab06/<handle>` and work there without pushing
matrix.note: Every PR in this lab targets main but is closed unmerged — never merge a plant fix into main

matrix.fixture: None — the rounding evidence is a test you run; there is no fixture substitute for it

credentials.fixture_only_story: Without Devin Review access you review the committed patch yourself, using the reference findings export as the reviewer's output: decide which findings are Bugs to fix, which Flag you accept or dispute and why, write the review rule you would add, then fix every actionable finding on a local throwaway branch and prove the rounding with a test. Criteria 2, 4 and 6 become observer-only; every other criterion is still yours.
not_exercised: Running Devin Review and choosing an effort level without the Review permission
Editing org review rules without admin rights

reset: git branch --list 'lab06/*' | grep -v 'lab06/price-drift-fix' | xargs -r git branch -D
scenarios.clean_state: `main` is at the latest commit with every planted defect intact (`price-drift` and `currency-rounding` in `services/api/PLANTED.md`). The exercise PR `fix(api): re-price cart lines from the current price list at checkout` (branch `lab06/price-drift-fix`, PR #26) is open and unmerged; if the facilitator closed it, recreate it from `fixtures/price-drift-fix.patch` on a branch of your own.

injectors.name: unchanged-diff-re-review
injectors.behaviour: Merge `main` into your copy of the PR branch when `main` has not moved, or push an empty commit, and ask for a re-review. Predict what Devin Review does before you look, then explain the result to the tech lead in one sentence.

injectors.name: bypassable-rule
injectors.behaviour: The PR ships `services/api/REVIEW.md`: money changes in `src/money.ts` need a pinned-amount test. The PR rounds money in `src/routes/checkout.ts` instead and never touches `money.ts`. Decide whether the rule fired, and replace it with one the next PR cannot walk around.

injectors.name: disputed-flag
injectors.behaviour: The PR author replies to the Investigate flag about per-line queries inside the checkout transaction: "Carts are capped in practice, two extra queries a line is nothing, and this is a flag, not a bug." Decide who is right with evidence, and record the outcome on the thread.

injectors.name: rounding-proof
injectors.when: before you claim the totals are safe
injectors.behaviour: With the regression test from your remediation branch in place, the run shows the subtotal the PR produces for two €19.90 Merino socks — the number the tech lead will ask for.
